purpose: Test whether the R0 exact meet can retain correctness while replacing exhaustive separator discovery with a cheap advisory proposal policy followed by exact separator verification.

training_and_design_disclosure.observed_R0_failure: separator discovery structural overhead dominated work
training_and_design_disclosure.observed_structural_separation: R0 structured family primal density was materially below dense controls; true/useful separator pairs were usually high degree-sum proposals.
training_and_design_disclosure.reason: Advisory route choice may use finalized prior evidence, but every chosen separator must still pass exact graph separation validation and root replay.

R1_mechanism.name: ADVISORY_PAIR_PROPOSAL_EXACT_VERIFY_DOUBLE_SPIRAL
online_steps: If graph density > 0.70, skip meet discovery and exact-fallback immediately.
Otherwise score all variable pairs only by structural degree sum.
Try at most 12 ranked pairs in frozen order.
For each proposal, exact-check that removing S disconnects the primal graph and deterministically split resulting components into two nonempty wings.
On first exact-valid separator, run the unchanged exact left/right boundary meet and root replay.
R1_mechanism.SAT_UNSAT_authority: independent exact root baseline in experiment; canonical TRUMP R5/C025 unchanged

primary: 24/24 terminal agreement with independent exact root baseline
16/16 structured cases expose an exact verified meet
gates.secondary_work: candidate charged abstract ops < baseline exact nodes over all 24 fresh cases
gates.dense_control: Dense cases may skip to exact fallback; density skip itself has zero truth authority.

next_if_pass: R2 shadow-only trial on fresh natural unenriched TRUMP residuals with R5/C025 exact replay and R6 authority boundaries unchanged.
